headlines.title: Federal prosecutors announce investigation into Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: Federal prosecutors announced that they are pursuing a criminal probe into the Alaska Senate race, where Democrats are facing allegations of election fraud. Democratic Alaskan Senate candidate Mary Peltola says she knew nothing about efforts to get another Dan Sullivan on the ballot to rival the incumbent, also named Dan Sullivan.

headlines.title: Appeals court again rejects DOJ’s bid to segregate over 20,000 alleged noncitizen ballots in California
headlines.description: A federal appeals court on Friday rejected the Trump administration’s latest bid to force California to set aside ballots from over 20,000 people it alleges might be noncitizens.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Binance says user funds are safe after thieves make off with billions in largest-ever crypto hack
headlines.description: A record-setting cyberattack targeting the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange has rocked the digital assets industry.

headlines.title: Tech stocks wipe out $1 trillion in value as concerns deepen about the AI boom
headlines.description: Tech stocks plunged, wiping out $1 trillion from Nasdaq 100 index companies.

headlines.title: Stock market reacts amid concerns about artificial intelligence spending
headlines.description: Watch a live look at the New York Stock Exchange big board as the market reacts to concerns about the current artificial intelligence boom.

headlines.title: Video shows ICE puncture Oregon couple’s car tire with a knife
headlines.description: Video captured by an Oregon couple appears to show ICE officers chasing them and puncturing their car tire with a knife.

headlines.title: Outcry prompts ‘Call of Duty’ to cut Seoul tragedy footage
headlines.description: American video game publisher Activision said Friday that it was removing controversial footage from its newly released “Call of Duty” game after an outcry in South Korea over the inclusion of real-life footage from a deadly 2022 Halloween crowd crush in Seoul.

headlines.title: Daylight Saving Time for 2026 Ends on Halloween Weekend
headlines.description: On Sunday morning, most Americans will “fall back” and switch their clocks back an hour to Standard time — and this year, the change is happening on Halloween weekend! NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Many on ACA plans face a new crisis in 2027: Insurers fleeing the market
headlines.description: Eleven insurers have announced plans to leave some state ACA marketplaces in 2027.

headlines.title: Steve Kornacki analyzes midterm election results live all night long
headlines.description: Follow NBC News Chief Data Analyst Steve Kornacki on camera and behind-the-scenes as he breaks down real-time vote tallies for the 2026 midterm elections.

headlines.title: U.S. approves $2.1 billion sale of Patriot interceptors to Ukraine
headlines.description: The Trump administration approved the sale of $2.1 billion in Patriot air defense systems to Ukraine on Friday, the State Department said in a statement.
